finding: Recursive conversion wrappers surround SFUN_CALL; error loop can call Scheme again, result conversion then marker kill then propagate
hazard: Call return or result assignment leaves conversion/marker/error effects
proposedReplacement: Generate acquisition/disposition/exit plan per three SFUN families, shared off-stack guarded exit service

finding: END_SFUN numeric/foreign argument conversions release still SCMOBJ after body; longjmp can bypass those lexical ends
hazard: All acquired conversions cannot be inferred from uninitialized or changed C locals after jump
proposedReplacement: Record acquisition after successful conversion; normal/exceptional path consumes each exact cleanup duty once

finding: build-c-lambda wraps optional cleanup TRY and AT_END; ___return uses goto local label; raw C text remains possible
hazard: Arbitrary return/longjmp/spawn bypasses local label or cleanup
proposedReplacement: Typed effect/exit manifest and managed return form; otherwise refuse controlled-cohort admission

finding: Generator defaults inline false; OOL avoids setjmp interfering with C TCO; caller spills/restores and inspects temp1 after cproc return
hazard: Callee close cannot release caller fp/register/status borrow or impose setjmp on every GVM host
proposedReplacement: Separate callee exit ticket and caller postlude ticket; keep qualified out-of-line boundary for TCO

finding: AT_END appears inside protected body before END_TRY then R_ALL_INL; an earlier throw skips AT_END
hazard: Moving AT_END after catch would newly execute user effects, not automatically preserve semantics
proposedReplacement: Record original execution condition; separate guaranteed service cleanup from optional user AT_END; explicit opt-in for changed semantics

finding: CFUN_CONV_ERROR excludes NO_ERR and UNWIND; ordinary errors set temp fields then inline jump/OOL return before subsequent propagate_error
hazard: Blanket claim every error executes propagate_error or END_CFUN misses real exits
proposedReplacement: Distinct handler-return and UNWIND propagation tickets; outer caller remains pinned through read/reload/dispatch

finding: END_CFUN function/string conversions release RC-backed native values; string-list release can release child strings
hazard: Conversion lexical scope includes cleanup after user body/AT_END; skipping duplicates loses roots/resources
proposedReplacement: Acquired-only cleanup ledger with native/root/code ownership; exact helper effect profile, no speculative cleanup replay

finding: TRY saves old catcher, installs local jbuf, reads longjmp_err on jump and END restores old pointer; setup initializes catcher0
hazard: Stack jbuf and saved predecessor require live target/thread; restoration is PSTATE write
proposedReplacement: Pin exact catcher chain and native activation; restore before source borrow release; off-stack service state

finding: NO_ERR propagate returns; otherwise throw_error executes THROW setting longjmp_err and jumping via catcher
hazard: Seal before propagation misses a physical PSTATE write; replay can jump twice or to dead target
proposedReplacement: Reserve successor propagation debt and target pin before close; only original qualified thread executes jump

finding: Local TRY exits restore catcher; trampoline trip can repeat; only matching marker UNWIND restores fp/R0, nonmatch rethrows
hazard: Treating trampoline trip as final exit or dropping outer target pin loses live activation
proposedReplacement: Keep guard for internal trips; matching return has explicit postlude; nonmatch hands debt outward before jump

finding: ___run marker kill is inside TRY normal path; marker construction may allocate with input-root TODO
hazard: A thrown ___call can skip kill; new universal cleanup cannot free a marker still borrowed elsewhere
proposedReplacement: Guarded acquisition and canonical retirement result; protect proc before allocation; root/return-right duties remain separate

finding: CFUN context reload and temp1/handler dispatch lead to JUMPRET; exact host macros depend on target
hazard: R_ALL or temp publication after callee seal remains source PSTATE access
proposedReplacement: Keep caller ticket until final source access or explicit GVM successor handoff; no whole-PSTATE0 from local guard

finding: Sweep/cleanup clears foreign release fields and calls release_fn; generator emits release wrappers or supplied id
hazard: Native side effect may outlive wrapper or throw; cleared fields alone do not prove disposition
proposedReplacement: Reserve callback task/root/native/code duty before destructive detach, only admitted exception/thread/effect profiles

finding: Normal service invokes execute_fn outside queue lock; cleanup invokes execute_fn(intr,false) while holding lock
hazard: Release callback reentrant enqueue can need same mutex; queue empty is not external admission closed
proposedReplacement: Close producers and reserve work before callback; do not wait/reenter under lock; source adaptation remains open

finding: Shrink/rollback/shutdown destroy PSTATE memory; ignored join follows shrink; VM later destroys shared facilities
hazard: An exception-close receipt does not retain physical backing or prove native thread termination
proposedReplacement: Require VM acceptance, independent root/domain and all pins0 before data cleanup; failed/unknown join keeps native envelope

finding: Header selects compiler builtin/library/dynamic import; BEGIN_TRY assigns setjmp return to err; real native callbacks exercise wrappers
hazard: ISO context/local/thread rules and GCC builtin constraints differ; unqualified raw longjmp/foreign ABI cannot be inferred safe
proposedReplacement: Modern C emitter gives explicit backend profile; standard setjmp in permitted context; portable guard state and no cross-thread helper jump
